metadata.title: Yoten Labs | AI-native product studio
metadata.description: Yoten Labs designs, builds, and operates AI-native software for teams that need clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes.

hero.title: AI-native products, built for scale and reliability.
hero.description: Yoten Labs designs, builds, and operates software where AI is the core system behind the experience and the operation. We combine product thinking, production engineering, and disciplined delivery for B2C and B2B teams.

panel.label: Positioning
panel.description: We prioritize clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes across data workflows, retrieval and generation pipelines, guardrails, evaluation, monitoring, and scalable delivery.

metrics.label: Core systems designed around AI from day one.
Real products with operational controls and clear ownership.
Evaluation, guardrails, and reliability built into the stack.
Delivery tied to measurable improvement, not vanity metrics.

yoten.label: Yoten
yoten.description: Yōten (要点) means 'key point' or 'essentials', a reminder to focus on what matters and ship with clarity.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
whatWeDo.description: The MVP stays focused, but the core system is built for production pressure from the start.

items.title: AI-native product development
items.description: Product strategy, UX, and engineering shaped around AI as the operating system, not a feature layer.

items.title: RAG and generation pipelines
items.description: Retrieval, orchestration, prompt design, and generation flows designed for useful outputs and stable operations.

items.title: Evaluation and monitoring
items.description: We instrument quality, latency, cost, and behavior so teams can improve with evidence.

items.title: Guardrails and safety
items.description: Controls for permissions, risky outputs, policy boundaries, and predictable user-facing behavior.

items.title: Cost, quotas, reliability
items.description: Quota enforcement, fallback paths, and operational limits that keep AI features economically sane.

items.title: B2C and B2B delivery
items.description: Consumer and enterprise products delivered with clear scope, reliable execution, and room to scale.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.description: The work stays practical: align, build, evaluate, and operate with the same level of discipline.

steps.title: Align on outcomes
steps.description: We define the user problem, the operational target, and the measurable result before building.

steps.title: Build the core system
steps.description: We implement the workflows, retrieval and generation layers, interfaces, and controls that matter.

steps.title: Evaluate and harden
steps.description: We pressure-test prompts, outputs, latency, quotas, and edge cases before widening exposure.

steps.title: Ship and operate
steps.description: We launch with monitoring, ownership, and iteration loops that keep the product improving.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Products and ventures built or operated inside Yoten Labs.

cards.name: WearingDaily
cards.description: Consumer fashion app for fast outfit generation using deterministic formulas, curated catalog completion, saved looks, packs twice a week, optional photo try-on, and video try-on as a paid premium feature.

cards.name: Live-Drills
cards.tagline: AI coaching for real training practice
cards.description: AI training platform with video/voice avatar and guided role-play sessions for CX, sales/negotiation, and procedures/onboarding. Includes rounds, coaching pauses, re-runs, and bilingual coach responses (pt-BR/en-US). Uses customer manuals, documents, videos, and images as training source, supports media playback during sessions, runs on LiveKit Cloud for real-time events, and ships with multi-tenant + RBAC architecture, plan/feature controls, and prompt quality evaluation workflows.

cards.name: Sanu
cards.description: Production healthcare operations platform available at trysanu.com, with multi-tenant foundations for RBAC, documents, scheduling, billing events, and real-time session flows designed for clarity, trust, and measurable outcomes.

items.question: Do you only build MVPs?
items.answer: No. We can shape the MVP, but we build the core system with production constraints in mind.

items.question: Do you work with enterprise teams?
items.answer: Yes. We build for both B2C and B2B contexts, including multi-tenant and operational platforms.

items.question: Do you handle reliability and controls?
items.answer: Yes. Guardrails, monitoring, quotas, and cost controls are part of the delivery scope.

items.question: Can you work on voice and real-time products?
items.answer: Yes. Real-time sessions, roleplay systems, and voice-first experiences are active areas for us.

metadata.title: Yoten Labs Pitch Deck | AI Product Studio
metadata.description: Investor-focused pitch deck for Yoten Labs, an AI Product Studio building owned products with real AI applications, starting with Sanu.

hero.title: We build AI products that solve real problems, starting with Sanu.
hero.description: Yoten Labs is an AI Product Studio focused on building owned assets with real AI applications. We combine deep engineering, product judgment, and strategic communication to move AI-native systems from concept into production.

signals.label: We build AI products, not just projects or isolated demos.
A healthcare platform in production, with real workflows and multi-tenant architecture.
Services, reusable components, and owned stack accelerate new assets.

problem.title: AI is still trapped in POCs and superficial layers.
problem.description: Companies can test models, but struggle to turn AI into operational workflows with real impact. Without product integration, data, permissions, evaluation, and operations, AI becomes an expensive and unreliable experiment.
points: AI projects often stop before reaching the user workflow that matters.
Teams lack architecture that connects LLMs, data, permissions, observability, and cost controls.
Value appears when AI operates inside the product, not as a peripheral feature.

solution.title: We do not just deliver projects: we create reusable AI products.
solution.description: Yoten Labs turns real problems into owned products, with components, patterns, and infrastructure that can be reused across verticals. Each delivery increases the speed of the next asset.
points: AI applied directly inside business, support, operations, and decision workflows.
Iterative build cycles across product, engineering, testing, and operations.
Reuse of architecture, AI components, integrations, guardrails, and delivery patterns.

approach.title: The advantage is AI engineering shipped to production.
approach.description: We build with a pragmatic stack and focus on systems that work under real constraints: latency, cost, security, tenant isolation, answer quality, and user experience.
points: Architecture with LLMs, RAG, agents, pipelines, embeddings, evaluation, and guardrails.
Stack with OpenAI, DSPy, FastAPI, Go, Next.js, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Redis, LiveKit, and Docker.
KISS, DRY, DDD, Clean Architecture, and Ports and Adapters keep speed without sacrificing maintainability.

businessModel.title: Services fund and accelerate owned AI products.
businessModel.description: The studio model remains, but with sharper focus: projects and services create cash flow, market contact, and reusable components; owned assets capture long-term value.
points: Builds and services generate market learning and validate real workflows.
Owned products compound intellectual property, infrastructure, and future distribution.
Each cycle grows Yoten Labs' component library and build speed.

differentiation.title: The founding team combines deep AI with narrative and market strength.
differentiation.description: Yoten Labs combines experience in critical systems, LLMs, and software architecture with strategic communication, PR, audiovisual, and positioning clarity. That reduces the distance between product built, market understood, and story told well.
points: Experience across distributed systems, payments, banking, cloud, messaging, and critical products.
Ability to turn problems into products, with AI integrated into the core workflow.
Communication and go-to-market strength to explain complex products clearly.

roadmap.title: Evolve Sanu and expand the portfolio of AI-native assets.
roadmap.description: The priority is to consolidate Sanu as execution proof, strengthen reusable AI infrastructure, and create new owned products where real workflows need applied intelligence.
points: Near term: strengthen Sanu, demos, operational quality, and product narrative.
Mid term: expand AI modules, evaluation, automation, and reusable components.
Long term: build a portfolio of owned products supported by services, partnerships, and distribution.

team.title: Two complementary founders to build and position AI assets.
team.description: For an early-stage company, the team is the core proof point. Yoten Labs starts with the technical depth to build complex products and the communication strength to turn technology into narrative, trust, and market.

sanu.title: Sanu: a healthcare operations platform already in production.
sanu.description: Sanu is the first concrete proof of the thesis: a multi-tenant SaaS product for clinical operations, connecting scheduling, teleconsultation, documents, support, billing, role-based access, and assistive AI into one operational experience.

cards.label: What it is
cards.title: Multi-tenant clinical SaaS
cards.description: A platform for organizing clinical operations with tenant, organization, subunit, and role-based boundaries.

cards.label: Audience
cards.title: Clinics and healthcare teams
cards.description: Serves doctors, admins, secretaries, patients, and platform operators through role-specific workflows.

cards.label: Problem
cards.title: Fragmented operations
cards.description: Reduces the gap between scheduling, teleconsultation, documents, support, billing, compliance, and clinical AI.

cards.label: Today
cards.title: Running product
cards.description: Flows exist for authentication, scheduling, LiveKit rooms, documents, guest access, billing, and support.

cards.label: AI
cards.title: Clinical RAG and automation
cards.description: Separate AI service with clinical RAG, embeddings, guardrails, summarization, extraction, and optimization track.

capabilities: LiveKit teleconsultation for doctor, patient, and guest access
RBAC with Casbin, tenant isolation, and platform/tenant domains
Clinical and administrative documents with LGPD-style gates
Clinical RAG with PostgreSQL/pgvector and a separate FastAPI service
Billing, plans, entitlements, and lifecycle events
Observability with structured logs, metrics, and Docker deployment

founders.name: Felipe Cavalcante Ogata
founders.description: AI engineer and software architect with 15+ years in backend, distributed systems, cloud, and critical platforms. Leads the technical construction of Yoten Labs products.
highlights: Experience with RAG, LLMs, agents, DSPy, OpenAI Realtime API, and prompt engineering.
Worked across DOT Digital Group, Grupo Casas Bahia, Banco Mercantil, Getnet, Deloitte, Farfetch, Superdigital/Santander, and Zurich.
Strong foundation in DDD, Clean Architecture, Ports and Adapters, microservices, messaging, and critical systems.

founders.name: Roberta Silveira
founders.description: Specialist in strategic communication, PR, journalism, audiovisual, and market context. Brings narrative clarity, public relations, and go-to-market capacity to complex products.
highlights: Experience in agribusiness communication, financial markets, national media, and public positioning.
Worked as PR Manager at Máquina Cohn & Wolfe and as anchor/reporter at Canal Rural.
Background in Journalism, Audiovisual Communication, Capital Markets, Cybersecurity, and Philosophy.

cta.title: Let's discuss the creation of owned assets with applied AI.
cta.description: Yoten Labs is building AI products with a focus on execution, technical reuse, and real problems. Sanu is the first production asset in this thesis.
